SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - NOVEMBER 19, 2018 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

8A.
Recommendation by the Cerritos Planning Commission, on a vote of 4-0, with one Commissioner absent, to approve the following:
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2001-4(2018) RENEWAL, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT SYNERGY DEVELOPMENT SERVICES, INC., ON BEHALF OF T-MOBILE WEST CORPORATION, TO RENEW AN EXISTING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ON A SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON TRANSMISSION TOWER. THE EXISTING WIRELESS FACILITY CONTAINS SIX (6) PANEL ANTENNAS, THREE (3) REMOTE RADIO UNITS, AND THREE (3) TOWER-MOUNTED AMPLIFIERS, AND LOCATED BENEATH THE SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON TRANSMISSION TOWER IS AN EXISTING EQUIPMENT ENCLOSURE THAT CONTAINS FOUR (4) SUPPORT EQUIPMENT CABINETS AND ONE (1) GLOBAL POSITIONING ANTENNA FOR WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PURPOSES. NO CHANGES TO THE EXISTING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ARE PLANNED WITH THE RENEWAL REQUEST. THE SUBJECT TOWER IS LOCATED AT 19900 CLARETTA AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 AND IS ZONED OPEN SPACE (OS) (APN 7056-006-800) (COUNCIL).*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

8A.  Recommendation by the Cerritos Planning Commission, on a vote of 4-0,

  CALIFORNIA EDISON TRANSMISSION TOWER. THE EXISTING WIRELESS

  UNITS, AND THREE (3) TOWER-MOUNTED AMPLIFIERS, AND LOCATED
  BENEATH THE SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON TRANSMISSION TOWER IS AN
  EXISTING EQUIPMENT ENCLOSURE THAT CONTAINS FOUR (4) SUPPORT

  WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PURPOSES. NO CHANGES TO THE EXISTING

  REQUEST. THE SUBJECT TOWER IS LOCATED AT 19900 CLARETTA AVENUE,
  CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 AND IS ZONED OPEN SPACE (OS) (APN 7056-
  006-800) (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Sandy Cisneros, Senior Planner. A PowerPoint

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor

  CORPORATION,  TO  RENEW  AN  EXISTING  WIRELESS

  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to direct and
  authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute and implement the
  agreement entitled Recycled Water Purchase Agreement by the City of Cerritos
  and Golden State Water Company, substantially in the form presented in the
  agenda report and subject to final review and approval by the City Attorney
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5– 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of award of Bid No. 1347-18, a contract for the
  annual on-call maintenance and repair services for water wells, booster pump
  assemblies and gear drives for the City of Cerritos (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vince Brar, Senior Assistant City Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Solanki, to award a contract
  for the annual on-call maintenance and repair services for water wells, booster
  pump assemblies and gear drives, Bid No. 1347-18, to General Pump Company
  and authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any contract
